grid_source_controls.scope: Independent finite checks of established grid packing and reflected-complement/fan invariance. The literal standard-set equality in the later chapter is not used.

rational_probe_specialization.scope: For every r>=8,s>=6 the fixed coefficient rule has a nontrivial relation on 23 ground columns, whereas a unit minor proves that a generic polynomial F has rank 23 there. This establishes specialization of the probe, not monotonicity of fan counts or an asymptotic lower bound.

coherent_specialization.scope: For r=2a,s=2b,F=x+y+t*x^a*y^b, t nonzero, the note proves one coherent standard set in every field whenever a,b>=1. For a>=4,b>=3 it contains a monomial universally excluded by the fixed rational probe. This distinguishes actual initial ideals, not just arbitrary column subsets; it does not compare total fan counts.

ordinary_cut_comparisons.scope: A nonuniform label means some strict weights in that cone reject the first n nonzero monomials. Equality labels are checked on every polygon vertex and hence on the whole cone. No total ordinary-cut count or asymptotic growth is inferred.

coherent_skip_obstruction.uniform_scope: Every q>=3 and every F with nonzero x and y linear coefficients over characteristic zero, or characteristic greater than 2q-2, has this coherent-prefix obstruction. Finite controls use the fixed coefficient rule modulo 101.
coherent_skip_obstruction.scope: A growing family of genuine dependent prefixes, not an inference from an arbitrary column circuit. This does not establish growing fan counts; the linear F control has at most five cones.

generic_diagonal_graph.scope: For finite abelian character tables the note proves the generic diagonal-power full-rank property by transitive row matroids and classical matroid partition. Here determinant polynomials are expanded directly in row parameters, not evaluated at random parameters. No statement about finite-field scalar specialization, conditioning or algorithmic speed is inferred.

support_matching_obstruction.scope: A coefficient-sensitive dependence persists for every square size in the written proof. Exact integer convolution and modular elimination validate the listed fixtures. This rejects a support-only rank shortcut; it is not an asymptotic initial-ideal theorem.
